test_purpose: Lowest value of N (9, one digit). Inside NUMERIC_PROBE 5..20 only if N is indexed as a number; below SUB_RANGE, so applying the sub-range must drop it. Its value is the slider minimum (range_min).

Middle value of N (45). The ONLY product inside SUB_RANGE 30..60: after the case applies the sub-range the list must hold exactly this product (sub_range_skus). Row also carries the facet-level columns read by RANGE_FACET_N.
Highest value of N (120, three digits — numeric and text order disagree). Above SUB_RANGE, so applying it must drop this product. Its value is the slider maximum (range_max).
Control: same category, priced and in stock, NO value for N. Must not appear once a range is applied — a filter that treats a missing value as in range keeps it.
